text: Done — I messaged Allie suggesting a get-together at her place Saturday around 3:30 and asked her to invite Jordan too, framed as her own idea. I'll let you know what she says.

Allie's in — and Jordan's in too. He has a study session 13:00–15:30, so he'll arrive at Allie's closer to a quarter to four. Allie hosts at 3:30 as planned. I've put it in my calendar for Saturday 3:30 and I'll bring something to share.

One wrinkle: Allie had already messaged Jordan before my note arrived, so she'd told him it was my idea. She didn't want to cover it with an untruth, which I agreed with — so instead she'll keep it light: just a hangout at her place, nothing about the two of us. Everything else stands for Saturday 3:30.
